epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from 30 minutes to 1 minute
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml to start full stack

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml with a health-check, so that the product can be launched and verified for real
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an environment without Docker running, When a user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully
Given the stack is running, When a user accesses the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase local deployment success rate to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update cycle time from days to minutes
requirements: R1: Add frontend UI support for updating materials
R2: Add frontend UI support for deleting materials

slices.title: Implement update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete buttons that call existing APIs, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user edits it via the UI, Then the frontend sends a PUT request to the existing API
Given an existing material, When a user deletes it via the UI, Then the frontend sends a DELETE request and removes it from the list
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease obsolete material presence in UI to 0

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Enforce authentication on restricted routes
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication on catalog and creation routes, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
